items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I remember going to see John Hammond one afternoon.

ctx.x: Where'd you get, where would you get?

A place called Bloomfields on 14th Street had bought out, supposedly, 150,000 Paramounts, some bankrupt distributor or something, I guess it was. John Hammond went through those first. He was just a kid then, probably high school or maybe going to Yale at that time. And that's where he got a lot of his collection. That's where he found, say, the Medlux Lewis record and those things that he began looking for Medlux Lewis a few years later before he found him. So they sold those for three cents a piece. And then…
Were these records brought into this store by record collectors? Or were they just there?
